description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Macro f-score across three different Frequency categories. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Frequency" and displays the categories in the order of "High", "Medium", and "Low". The vertical value axis is labeled "Macro f-score" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. The chart contains grouped bars for each frequency category, with each group consisting of two adjacent bars distinguished by color. According to the legend positioned below the chart, the light peach bars represent "RECA", while the dark orange bars correspond to a second category whose text label is visually obscured by a solid grey rectangle. Each bar is visually emphasized with an explicit annotation of its exact numerical value near the top. In the "High" frequency group, the light peach RECA bar has a value of 0.837, and the adjacent dark orange bar is the tallest in the chart at 0.877. In the "Medium" group, the RECA bar is 0.538 and the dark orange bar is 0.609. In the "Low" frequency group, the RECA bar represents the shortest value in the chart at 0.114, while the dark orange bar is 0.224. Across the chart, the grouped bars are arranged such that their heights consistently decrease from left to right across the three frequency categories.
